LEXICON / LANGUAGE & MEANING

Names in context.

Astrocartography
Astrocartografía

Astrological maps showing selected chart relationships across geographic locations.

Planetary hours
Horas planetarias

Astrological divisions of day and night assigned to a recurring sequence of planetary rulers.

PROVENANCE & INTERPRETATION

A practice,
a setting.

Astrocartography maps selected chart relationships onto places. Planetary-hour systems divide day and night into symbolic planetary sequences; the convention and location must be recorded.

FIELD NOTE / METHOD

Keep a record.

  1. State whether the record is a geographic map or a planetary-hour calculation.
  2. Retain the date, location and calculation conventions.
  3. Explain the symbolic interpretation with reference to the chosen school.
POTPOURRI / PHOTO GUIDE

What to include.

  • Send a map overview plus a close view with legend and coordinates.
  • For planetary hours, provide the full table and its sunrise, sunset and time-zone assumptions.
